decor.name: Seaweed Bunch
decor.description: A simple cluster of flowing seaweed that adds movement and a little extra life to the tank. Looks right at home tucked between rocks, caves, or other decorations.

decor.name: Mushroom Coral
decor.description: A low, rounded coral with soft curves and plenty of texture. An easy way to add a natural reef look without taking over the tank.

decor.name: Brain Coral
decor.description: A dense coral covered in winding, maze-like ridges. Compact, colorful, and just strange enough to earn its name.

decor.name: Branch Coral 1
decor.description: A branching coral formation that adds height, color, and a little reef complexity to the tank.

decor.name: Branch Coral 2
decor.description: A lively cluster of branching coral that helps fill open spaces with natural reef texture.

decor.name: Branch Coral 3
decor.description: A decorative branching coral with plenty of little arms reaching into the water around it.

decor.name: Branch Coral 4
decor.description: A colorful coral formation that brings a bit of reef structure and vertical interest to the aquarium.

decor.name: Branch Coral 5
decor.description: A branching coral cluster made for building out colorful reef scenes without overwhelming the tank.

decor.name: Branch Coral 6
decor.description: A compact branching coral that adds texture and depth wherever the tank is looking a little too empty.

decor.name: Branch Coral 7
decor.description: A decorative coral with branching growth that gives the tank a busier, more established reef look.

decor.name: Branch Coral 8
decor.description: A branching coral formation that works nicely tucked between rocks, caves, and other reef decorations.

decor.name: Branch Coral 9
decor.description: A colorful piece of branching coral that adds a little height and life to the aquarium floor.

decor.name: Branch Coral 10
decor.description: A natural-looking coral cluster with branching growth, perfect for rounding out a larger reef display.

decor.name: Coral Shelf Cave 1
decor.description: A rocky coral shelf with a sheltered space underneath. Part reef decoration, part cozy hiding place.

decor.name: Coral Shelf Cave 2
decor.description: A layered coral shelf that creates a shaded little retreat beneath the reef.

decor.name: Coral Shelf Cave 3
decor.description: A sturdy coral-covered shelf with enough room underneath for curious fish to disappear for a while.

decor.name: Coral Shelf Cave 4
decor.description: A reef shelf with a natural hollow beneath it, adding both height and a tucked-away hiding spot.

decor.name: Coral Shelf Cave 5
decor.description: A rugged coral shelf that gives the tank a bit of reef structure and a quiet space underneath.

decor.name: Coral Shelf Cave 6
decor.description: A raised coral formation with a sheltered opening below, perfect for breaking up an open aquarium floor.

decor.name: Coral Shelf Cave 7
decor.description: A broad reef shelf with a built-in hiding place beneath it. Basically beachfront property for fish.

decor.name: Coral Shelf Cave 9
decor.description: A rocky coral overhang that adds depth to the reef and a shady little spot underneath.

decor.name: Coral Shelf Cave 10
decor.description: A substantial coral shelf with a protected hollow below, giving the tank a more layered reef landscape.

decor.name: Sea Anemone 2
decor.description: A soft mass of waving tentacles that brings constant gentle movement to the aquarium. Clownfish may approve.

decor.name: Sea Anemone 5
decor.description: A colorful sea anemone with flowing tentacles that sway with the water and make the tank feel a little more alive.

decor.name: Sea Anemone Cave 1
decor.description: A cozy sea anemone. Cozy, colorful, and slightly wiggly.

decor.name: Sea Anemone Cave 3
decor.description: A cozy sea anemone. Cozy, colorful, and slightly wiggly.

decor.name: Sea Anemone Cave 4
decor.description: A cozy sea anemone. Cozy, colorful, and slightly wiggly.

decor.name: Dirt Mound
decor.description: A small mound of loose earth for giving the aquarium floor a more uneven, natural look. Sometimes dirt really is the decoration.

decor.name: Floating Seaweed
decor.description: Loose seaweed that drifts above the aquarium floor instead of staying politely planted where it belongs.

decor.name: Seaweed
decor.description: A simple patch of flowing seaweed that adds height, movement, and a little extra greenery to the tank.

decor.name: Anubias Rock
decor.description: A hardy Anubias growing directly from a rock. Conveniently combines plant and stone into one tidy little decoration.

decor.name: Moss Bridge
decor.description: A small bridge softened by a layer of moss. Equal parts peaceful garden feature and tiny fish infrastructure.

decor.name: Driftwood Root
decor.description: A gnarled mass of weathered roots that adds natural shape and texture to the aquarium floor.

decor.name: Slate Cave
decor.description: A sturdy little shelter built from stacked slate. Simple, rocky, and perfect for fish that appreciate some privacy.

decor.name: Shipwreck
decor.description: A sunken ship left to slowly become part of the aquarium. Dramatic enough to tell a story without taking the whole tank hostage.

decor.name: Castle Cave 2
decor.description: A miniature castle with enough openings and shelter to double as a proper fish hideout. Royal residency not guaranteed.

decor.name: Plane Crash
decor.description: A miniature aircraft wreck resting on the aquarium floor. The investigation remains ongoing.

decor.name: Castle Cave 1
decor.description: A tiny underwater castle that gives the tank a touch of fantasy and its residents somewhere suitably dramatic to hide.

decor.name: Meteor Cave
decor.description: A strange rocky formation that looks suspiciously like it fell from somewhere much farther away. Conveniently, it also has a cave.

decor.name: Driftwood
decor.description: A weathered piece of driftwood with plenty of natural bends and texture. Simple, classic, and nearly impossible to make look out of place.

decor.name: Fishing Lure
decor.description: A bright fishing lure placed inside an aquarium for reasons nobody has fully explained. Fortunately, the fish seem more curious than concerned.

decor.name: Gorebag
decor.description: A peculiar decoration known only as Gorebag. Nobody remembers where it came from, and asking questions has not helped.

decor.name: Neon Fish Head Effigy
decor.description: A bloody fish-head effigy. Tasteful is probably not the word, but memorable definitely is.

decor.name: Guppy Fish Head Effigy
decor.description: A guppy head mounted on a stake.

decor.name: Danio Fish Head Effigy
decor.description: A Danio fish-head effigy. Pretty ominous and completely unnecessary.

decor.name: Rock 1
decor.description: A rock. A perfectly respectable rock, in fact. Useful for filling gaps, building little landscapes, or simply adding more rock.

decor.name: Rock 2
decor.description: A simple aquarium rock for adding natural texture wherever the tank needs a little more structure.

decor.name: Rock 3
decor.description: A sturdy decorative rock that fits comfortably into just about any aquarium layout.

decor.name: Rock 4
decor.description: A natural-looking stone for breaking up open spaces and giving the aquarium floor a little more shape.

decor.name: Rock 5
decor.description: A straightforward piece of rock decor. No gimmicks, no bubbles, just dependable geology.

decor.name: Volcanic Rock 1
decor.description: A dark, rugged piece of volcanic rock with plenty of rough texture and character.

decor.name: Volcanic Rock 2
decor.description: A porous-looking volcanic stone that adds a harsher, more dramatic edge to the aquarium floor.

decor.name: Volcanic Rock 3
decor.description: A chunk of dark volcanic rock for building rocky formations, caves, or anything that needs a little ancient lava energy.

decor.name: Volcanic Rock 4
decor.description: A rough volcanic stone with a naturally dramatic look. Thankfully, the volcano part is no longer active.

decor.name: Volcano Bubbler 1
decor.description: A miniature volcano that continuously sends bubbles toward the surface. Considerably safer than the full-sized version. Also: Completely Adjustable and Customizable!

decor.name: Volcano Bubbler 2
decor.description: A bubbling volcanic decoration that adds constant movement to the tank without requiring an evacuation plan. Also: Completely Adjustable and Customizable!

decor.name: Treasure Chest Bubbler
decor.description: A little sunken treasure chest that releases a steady stream of bubbles. The treasure itself appears to be mostly air. Also: Completely Adjustable and Customizable!

decor.name: Floating Swamp Moss
decor.description: A loose patch of eerie swamp moss suspended in the water. Damp, gloomy, and somehow thriving.

decor.name: Borough Transit Tube

fishBehavior.note: Name and link two tubes to give fish a fast route between neighborhoods. It only bubbles while in use.

decor.description: Link two named tubes to create a fast route between neighborhoods. The tube stays quiet until a fish enters, then bubbles to life as it carries the fish across the Borough like an italian plumber.

decor.name: Floating Ghost
decor.description: A little ghost that quietly floats in the aquarium.

decor.name: Haunted Cauldron Bubbler
decor.description: A cauldron that churns away on the aquarium floor, releasing a steady stream of bubbles. Whatever is brewing inside probably should not be tasted. Also: Completely Adjustable and Customizable!

decor.name: Crypt Cave
decor.description: A miniature stone crypt with enough room inside for fish that prefer their hiding places a little more gothic.

decor.name: Haunted Floating Seaweed
decor.description: Eerie floating seaweed. It looks like it is rotting.

decor.name: Ghost Ship
decor.description: A spectral shipwreck that appears to have sailed directly into the aquarium. Its crew has yet to make themselves available for questions.

decor.name: Gravestone 1
decor.description: A tiny weathered gravestone for giving the aquarium floor a proper little graveyard atmosphere.

decor.name: Gravestone 2
decor.description: A miniature gravestone that adds just the right amount of unnecessary morbidity to the tank.

decor.name: Gravestone 3
decor.description: A worn little grave marker that looks perfectly at home among caves, dead plants, and other questionable aquarium decisions.

decor.name: Gravestone 4
decor.description: A small gravestone for building an underwater cemetery. Nobody is quite sure who is buried there.

decor.name: Gravestone 5
decor.description: A lonely little grave marker with just enough weathering to suggest it has been underwater much longer than it should have been.

decor.name: Haunted House Cave
decor.description: A miniature haunted house with enough room inside for brave fish, scared fish, or fish that simply want somewhere dark to sit.

decor.name: Haunted Tree
decor.description: A twisted old tree that looks thoroughly dead.

decor.name: Jack-o'-Lantern Bubbler
decor.description: A grinning jack-o'-lantern that releases a steady stream of bubbles. The pumpkin remains suspiciously intact underwater. Also: Completely Adjustable and Customizable!

decor.name: Haunted Seaweed
decor.description: Dark, eerie seaweed that sways in the tank with considerably more menace than ordinary seaweed should possess.

decor.name: Aquarium Spider
decor.description: A spider. In the aquarium. We agree that this raises several questions, but none of them have improved the situation.

decor.name: Floating Fish Skeleton
decor.description: A fish skeleton that quietly floats in the aquarium. It probably fake, though. Right?

decor.name: Aquarium Webs
decor.description: A little spider web to put wherever. How the web remains perfectly intact underwater is a problem for someone else to solve.

decor.name: Fishing Lure
decor.description: A colorful fishing lure dangling where no fishing should be happening. The fish seem fascinated by it, which is probably exactly what the lure wants.

decor.name: Fishing Lure
decor.description: A shiny little lure suspended in the aquarium. Completely harmless here, although the fish may have some understandable trust issues.

decor.name: Fishing Lure
decor.description: A fishing lure repurposed as aquarium decor. It catches attention instead of fish now.

decor.name: Fishing Lure
decor.description: A suspiciously enticing lure left hanging in the tank. No hook-related incidents have been reported.

decor.name: Fishing Lure
decor.description: A bright piece of fishing tackle that gives curious fish something unusual to investigate. Thankfully, nobody is actually fishing.

decor.name: Fishing Lure
decor.description: A decorative lure that sparkles just enough to get every nearby fish interested in absolutely nothing.
